commitResults.messageTitle: Assert canonical groups in parser tests
commitResults.messageBody: Check the exact student-group pair for every valid parser input. Assignment counts alone can miss an incorrect configured group.
Compare catalogues from the actual registers and cover a custom group across an unassignment save and reload. This catches lost catalogue data that live-model checks could miss.

commitResults.messageTitle: Show full long group codes in Groups list
commitResults.messageBody:
Valid 20-character group codes can be truncated in the fixed-width code column, making their identifiers difficult to retrieve.

Enable text wrapping to preserve the complete code without widening the column or hiding the group kind.

Add a JavaFX rendering regression covering text containment, row layout, and resizing.

commitResults.messageTitle: Reject duplicate add-group prefixes after tabs
commitResults.messageBody:
Tab-prefixed duplicate parameters can evade add-group validation and
become part of a label, contrary to the documented command contract.

Reject repeated canonical prefixes in the local validation scan.
Keep shared tokenization and existing label normalization unchanged.

Add regressions for all three prefixes, space-separated controls,
and valid labels containing whitespace or slashes.
